rejected_claims: Generated labor hours from service requirements: no productivity or labor basis was supplied.
Universal routing of valve bodies/actuators to trade budgets: guide-specific/project-adopted responsibility must be verified.
Automatic insulation material overrides from generic environment tags: selected passage context does not establish universal policy.
Blocking ERP export for protocol choice: generated behavior has no approved product or mechanical rule.
TAB physical scope limited to plugs/patching: unsupported exhaustive claim.
Using field TAB tolerances as software recognition/measurement acceptance thresholds: different objectives and no approved equivalence.
limits: The query does not enumerate all56 guide taxonomies.
Source-specific clauses do not automatically apply to another agency, edition or project.
New measurement/count/allowance policies and original-source accuracy thresholds require separately frozen task inputs; no values invented in these plans.
